Touching in and out

You need to touch in at the start and touch out at the end of your journey on the yellow card readers.

Why touch in and touch out

If you do not touch in and out you may be charged a maximum fare.

  • Tube, DLR and Elizabeth line: touch in and out
  • Buses and trams: touch in only

Touch pink card readers when changing trains

Touch the pink card readers when you change trains so you pay the right fare.
